problemSigns.detail: Your door hesitates or stops at the same point during opening or closing. This indicates a restriction in the track system.

problemSigns.sign: Visible bend or dent in track
problemSigns.detail: Inspect the vertical and horizontal tracks. Any deformation can prevent rollers from moving smoothly.
This is a serious safety concern. It means the track is bent, misaligned, or the rollers are worn beyond their safe operating limit.

problemSigns.sign: Gap between track and door frame
problemSigns.detail: The track should be securely fastened to the garage door frame. A gap suggests loose brackets or a bent track.
